subject.title: 🦞 Tracking: Connect & pair reliably — local and remote

question: Which component owns issuing and preserving correct node scopes and approval state for local and remote pairing: the gateway contract, the Windows client, or a coordinated change in both?
rationale: The reproduced empty-capability state remains after partial Windows-client hardening, and selecting the permanent token-scope and approval contract requires maintainer ownership across a security boundary.

options.title: Coordinate gateway and Windows contract
options.body: Keep this epic open and require the remote-pairing child to define and prove the gateway-issued scope contract plus Windows persistence and recovery behavior.

options.title: Assign gateway-only ownership
options.body: Track the scope issuance fix upstream while retaining only Windows diagnostics, recovery UX, and integration proof in this repository.

options.title: Assign Windows-only mitigation
options.body: Add a client-side recovery or compatibility path only if maintainers explicitly accept that it cannot correct invalid gateway-issued authorization state.

recommendation.title: Coordinate gateway and Windows contract
recommendation.body: Keep this epic open and require the remote-pairing child to define and prove the gateway-issued scope contract plus Windows persistence and recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They coordinate this epic and its cross-cutting child work, making them the best available router for the gateway-versus-Windows ownership decision.
